product: Edit Lakeflow Designer parameter expressions inline (Public Preview)
tagline: Edit parameter expressions directly in supported operator fields in Lakeflow Designer.
what_it_does: Edit parameter expressions directly in supported operator fields in Lakeflow Designer. Parameters in Lakeflow Designer are named values defined for the visual data prep as a whole. You can reference parameters in SQL and Python operator code, in supported operator configuration fields, and in expressions that enable or disable operators.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
